issues.description: The solution repository uses class names with a 'Space' prefix (SpaceSeal, SpacePig, SpaceGoat) while the problem statement and the template Main.java refer to Seal, Pig, and Goat. Additionally, the solution contains empty placeholder files named Seal.java, Pig.java, and Goat.java. This identifier mismatch will confuse students: they will expect to implement/use Seal/Pig/Goat as specified in the UML and template, but the provided implementations in the solution use different names, and the expected class files are empty. This can block students or confuse automated tests that expect the unprefixed class names.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the class names across artifacts. Either rename the solution classes to Seal, Pig, and Goat (e.g., SpaceSeal -> Seal) or update the problem statement and template to reference the 'Space' prefixed class names. Also remove or populate the empty placeholder files (Seal.java, Pig.java, Goat.java) so there is a single, consistent set of class names for students to implement and for tests to use.
